content.text:
# workflow_checkpoint_ask_selected — Ask human for selected checkpoint

Trusted terminal ingest for one explicitly selected feature/run checkpoint. Validates the exact selected state, capability, profile and policy before prompting a host UI, then mints the answer through one engine-owned CAS transaction. The UI supplies only one policy-allowed label; copy the returned proof and actor_provenance verbatim into workflow_checkpoint. No active-feature pointer or model-supplied UI surface is consulted.

## Schema
```ts
type Args = unknown;
```
Execute by writing JSON to xd://workflow_checkpoint_ask_selected.
